bugs.name: Out-of-range repository settings page falsely claims the account owns no repositories
bugs.summary: Requesting an out-of-range page in repository settings displays `You do not own any repositories` even though the account owns repositories.
bugs.expected: Out-of-range pagination should not claim that an account with repositories owns none.
bugs.actual: Requesting an out-of-range page in repository settings displays `You do not own any repositories` even though the account owns repositories.
reproSteps: Open the authenticated account's repository settings and confirm that owned repositories are listed.
Open the same repository settings route with an out-of-range page such as `?page=999`.
Observe that the page falsely says `You do not own any repositories` instead of indicating that the requested page has no results.

bugs.name: Follower card content does not scale to mobile grid columns
bugs.summary: At mobile width, follower cards retain content sizing and secondary fields that do not fit their grid columns, fragmenting display names and URLs.
bugs.expected: Adapt avatar/icon sizing, typography or displayed fields to the available mobile card width so follower identity remains readable. A three-column grid is acceptable; compact content, deliberate truncation or omitting secondary fields can satisfy this without making each card fill the row.
bugs.actual: In the recorded 390×844 view, the follower card occupies roughly 120px while its avatar and text consume most of that width. The display name Eval Profile Sample 2026 splits within words, including Eva / l, and the website wraps into many short fragments. The supplied review screenshot shows the same mismatch between narrow columns and the retained avatar, type and metadata content.
reproSteps: Use the supplied authenticated eval session and set the viewport to 390 by 844 CSS pixels. Precondition: eval follows target profile mo-followerslist-4827639 and has display name Eval Profile Sample 2026 plus a website URL.
Open the target profile at /mo-followerslist-4827639 and click its visible 1 Followers count.

Inspect the follower card’s avatar, display name and website. Observe that the retained content sizing and fields leave too little room for the name beside the avatar, splitting it within words, while the URL wraps into many short lines.

Assess whether the content remains readable within the mobile column. The reported defect is the content scaling and prioritization; retaining three columns or unused slots when only one follower exists is acceptable.

bugs.name: Profile editor cannot clear Full Name
bugs.summary: Submitting an empty Full Name reports success but leaves the previous name saved; it remains populated after refresh.
bugs.expected: After submitting the profile form with Full Name empty, the optional field should remain empty and the cleared value should persist after refresh.
bugs.actual: The form displayed “Your profile has been updated,” but Full Name still showed “mo-gitea-05-account-profile-temp.” Refreshing the profile page showed the same saved value.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval.
Open the eval account menu, choose Settings, and open Profile at /user/settings. The Full Name field was already populated with the disposable value rather than blank.
Set Full Name to mo-gitea-05-account-profile-temp and click Update Profile; the page reports that the profile has been updated.
Clear Full Name and click Update Profile again.
Observe the success message while the Full Name field still contains mo-gitea-05-account-profile-temp. Refresh /user/settings and verify the value remains populated.

bugs.name: Blocking a nonexistent username returns HTTP 500
bugs.summary: Submitting a unique username that does not exist on the Blocked users page opens a 500 error page.
bugs.expected: The form should reject an unknown user with a validation message.
bugs.actual: Submitting a unique username that does not exist on the Blocked users page opens a 500 error page.
reproSteps: Open User Settings → Blocked users.
Enter a unique nonexistent username and click Block.
Observe the 500 Internal Server Error page.

bugs.name: Zero-followers profile tab has no empty state
bugs.summary: The 0 Followers link opens a blank content area with no explanation or empty-state text.
bugs.expected: The Followers tab should explain that the account has no followers.
bugs.actual: The 0 Followers link opens a blank content area with no explanation or empty-state text.
reproSteps: Open the eval profile and click 0 Followers.
Observe the empty content area at ?tab=followers.

bugs.name: Public Profile description uses incorrect grammar
bugs.summary: The profile settings introduction says “Control how your profile is show to other users.”
bugs.expected: The sentence should say “shown to other users.”
bugs.actual: The profile settings introduction says “Control how your profile is show to other users.”
reproSteps: Open User Settings → Profile.
Read the Public Profile introductory sentence.

bugs.name: Unfollowing a user from their Followers tab leaves your card in the list until reload
bugs.summary: On a user's Followers tab, clicking Unfollow updates the sidebar count and button to Follow, but your follower card stays in the list until the page is reloaded.
bugs.expected: After clicking Unfollow on a user's Followers tab, your card is removed from the Followers list, matching the updated follower count.
bugs.actual: The sidebar shows the lower follower count and a Follow button, but your card stays in the Followers list, even after waiting. Reloading removes it.
reproSteps: Sign in, open another user's profile, and follow them.
Open their Followers tab and confirm your card is listed.
Click Unfollow in the sidebar.
Check whether your card is removed from the list, then reload and check again.

relatedReference.name: Following a user from their Followers tab doesn't add your card to the list until reload
relatedReference.distinction: Same Followers tab and cause (Follow/Unfollow refreshes only the sidebar), but that entry is Follow not adding your card; this entry is Unfollow leaving your card.

bugs.name: Mobile avatar file input is clipped
bugs.summary: At a 320px width, the avatar file input extends past the settings card and is clipped by the viewport.
bugs.expected: At a 320×700 viewport, the avatar file chooser should fit within the Avatar card without its control border extending beyond the viewport. Filename truncation within a correctly sized control is acceptable.
bugs.actual: On /user/settings, the file chooser’s outlined field continues past the Avatar card’s right edge and reaches the viewport edge, where it is clipped. The clipping remained visible after waiting five seconds.
reproSteps: Set the browser viewport to 320×700 CSS pixels and sign in with the authorized fixture account.
Choose Settings from the account menu to open /user/settings.
Scroll to the Avatar card and inspect the Choose new avatar file chooser.
Observe that its outlined field extends beyond the card and is clipped at the viewport’s right edge; wait for the layout to settle and confirm the overflow remains.

bugs.name: Profile edits are cleared after invalid Website URL submission
bugs.summary: Submitting a profile with an unsupported Website URL displays a validation error but re-renders the profile form with previously saved values, discarding unsaved Full Name, Biography, Website, and Location edits.
bugs.expected: Reject the Website URL while retaining all submitted profile values in the form so the user can correct the URL without losing other edits.
bugs.actual: With Website set to ftp://example.com/profile and distinct unsaved values in Full Name, Biography and Location, Update Profile displays `form.Website "Url" is not a valid URL.` and all four fields immediately revert to their previously saved values without a manual reload, discarding the submitted draft. In the recorded fixture the previously saved values were blank.
reproSteps: Sign in and open Settings > Profile. Record the currently saved Full Name, Biography, Website and Location values.
Enter distinct new draft values in Full Name, Biography and Location; enter ftp://example.com/profile as Website.
Click Update Profile. Observe the Website URL validation error.
Inspect the four fields immediately without refreshing: they contain their previously saved values, losing the submitted draft. Correcting the Website URL now requires re-entering the other edits.

matchingGuidance.scope: Unsaved submitted draft input is lost after recoverable validation. Already saved profile values are not erased.

bugs.name: Profile repository Filter and Sort menus open above the mobile viewport
bugs.summary: On a user profile's repository tabs at phone width, the Filter and Sort menus open upward from their buttons even though there is room below, so their top options are cut off above the screen and cannot be scrolled into view.
bugs.expected: At phone width the profile Filter and Sort menus open where all options are visible, or the menu scrolls so every option can be reached.
bugs.actual: At 390×844 on a profile's Starred tab with the page scrolled to the top, Filter opened upward starting about 21px above the viewport, cutting off Clear Filter, and Sort started about 18px above it, cutting off Newest. At 320px wide Newest was mostly hidden. Scrolling up did not reveal them. Desktop widths and Explore > Repositories open normally.
reproSteps: Sign in and open your profile's Starred (or Repositories) tab at 390×844, scrolled to the top.
Tap Filter next to the repository search box and look at the top of the menu.
Close it, tap Sort, and look at the top option, Newest.

bugs.name: Profile Website validation error shows an internal field key
bugs.summary: Saving the profile with an invalid Website URL shows an error banner that names the field with an internal translation key, form.Website"Url", instead of the readable field name.
bugs.expected: The Website validation error names the field in readable language, for example 'Website is not a valid URL'.
bugs.actual: Entering ftp://example.org (or a javascript: or mailto: value) in Website and clicking Update Profile showed the banner `form.Website"Url" is not a valid URL.` at both mobile and desktop widths.
reproSteps: Open Settings > Profile.
Enter ftp://example.org in Website and click Update Profile.
Read the error banner at the top of the page.

relatedReference.distinction: Same invalid Website submission. That entry is the other profile edits being cleared; this entry is the error banner's wording exposing an internal field key.

bugs.name: Unblocking an administrator account from Blocked Users fails
bugs.summary: A regular user can block an administrator account, and the block is listed under Settings > Blocked Users, but clicking Unblock on it fails with 'cannot unblock the user' and the administrator stays on the list.
bugs.expected: Clicking Unblock removes the blocked administrator from the Blocked Users list, as it does for any other blocked user.
bugs.actual: A non-admin user blocked the administrator account eval from its profile, and eval was listed under Blocked Users. Clicking Unblock showed 'Failed to unblock user: cannot unblock the user', and eval stayed on the list after refresh.
reproSteps: Sign in as a non-admin user and open an administrator's profile.
Click Block user and confirm.
Open Settings > Blocked Users and click Unblock for the administrator.

bugs.name: Clicking a contribution calendar day shows the wrong activity when the browser and server timezones differ
bugs.summary: The profile contribution calendar groups activity by the browser's local day, but clicking a day filters the activity list by that date in the server's timezone. For viewers in another timezone, a day's square can open an empty list or a list that doesn't match its contribution count.
bugs.expected: Clicking a calendar day lists the activity counted in that day's square.
bugs.actual: In a Los Angeles browser against a UTC server, the square '12 contributions - Oct 23, 2026' opened ?date=2026-10-23 with no activity, while the next square '6 contributions - Oct 24' listed 18 entries. In a UTC browser the same click listed exactly the advertised entries. The dashboard calendar behaves the same.
reproSteps: Set the browser timezone several hours away from the server's (for example America/Los_Angeles against a UTC server).
Create some activity, then open your profile's Public Activity tab.
Hover a filled calendar square to read its count, click it, and compare the activity listed.

bugs.name: Avatar size error says the file's size equals the maximum it exceeds
bugs.summary: Uploading an avatar that is slightly over the 1 MiB limit is correctly rejected, but the error reads 'The uploaded file size (1024 KiB) exceeds the maximum size (1024 KiB).' The file size is rounded down to whole KiB, so any file up to 1023 bytes over the limit shows the same number as the maximum.
bugs.expected: The error shows the file's size precisely enough to differ from the maximum, or simply says the file is larger than the 1024 KiB limit.
bugs.actual: Uploading a 1,048,577-byte PNG (one byte over 1 MiB) as the avatar showed 'The uploaded file size (1024 KiB) exceeds the maximum size (1024 KiB).'
reproSteps: Open Settings > Profile.
Choose a valid image file between 1,048,577 and 1,049,599 bytes as the new avatar.
Click Update Avatar and read the error message.

bugs.name: Following a user from their Followers tab doesn't add your card to the list until reload
bugs.summary: On a user's Followers tab, clicking Follow updates the sidebar count and button to Unfollow, but your follower card isn't added to the list until the page is reloaded.
bugs.expected: After clicking Follow on a user's Followers tab, your card appears in the Followers list, matching the updated follower count.
bugs.actual: The sidebar shows the new follower count and an Unfollow button, but the list keeps its previous cards (or stays empty for a user with no followers). Reloading shows your card.
reproSteps: Sign in and open another user's profile whom you don't follow.
Open their Followers tab and note the cards listed.
Click Follow in the sidebar.
Check whether your card appears in the list, then reload and check again.

relatedReference.name: Unfollowing a user from their Followers tab leaves your card in the list until reload
relatedReference.distinction: Same Followers tab and cause (Follow/Unfollow refreshes only the sidebar), but that entry is Unfollow leaving your card in the list; this entry is Follow not adding your card.

bugs.name: Projects search clears the entered query after submitting it
bugs.summary: On a user's or organization's Projects page, submitting a search filters the list but reloads with the search box empty, and the Open, Closed and sort links drop the search, so switching state or sort loses it.
bugs.expected: After searching projects, the search box keeps the query and the Open, Closed and sort links keep the search applied.
bugs.actual: After submitting a query, the page reloaded with the search box showing only the 'Search projects...' placeholder; clicking Closed or a sort option then showed results without the search.
reproSteps: Open a user's or organization's Projects page with several projects.
Search for a word from one project's title and submit.
Check the search box, then click Closed (or change the sort) and check whether the search is still applied.
